answer.explanation: From 21:12:52.906 (the window start) every Thumbnailer invocation fails at S3 PutObject with NoSuchBucket, and there are no bucket errors before that in the 19:00-21:30 logs. The error is NoSuchBucket, not AccessDenied, so the target bucket is missing or misnamed; the IAM role is unlikely to be the cause. The other three functions show no errors in the window. The likely cause is the OUTPUT_BUCKET environment variable on the Thumbnailer pointing at a nonexistent bucket, after a live configuration change. I could not read the live environment variables or the template, so the IaC and IAM candidates are unverified and the variable value is unconfirmed.
